what_to_test:
1.2.0 雲端測試版（omi-app-dev）。
教學最後可選 Discord 登入，或略過並在本機使用；訪客看不到其他玩家。登入後建立或加入群組，測試打卡、私人心得、照片同步、登出及重開。舊本機紀錄需另外確認匯入才上傳。
請協助驗證 iOS 真機登入與雙裝置同步；目前僅 Chrome 實測。雲端模式的小工具需開啟 App 記錄與同步，背景打卡尚未完成。帳號與雲端資料自助刪除尚未完成，請先使用測試資料。
beta_description: Omi 是社群的好習慣挑戰 App：運動、飲食、閱讀、睡眠與反思。可不登入在本機使用；TestFlight 1.2.0 起可選 Discord 登入並建立／加入群組，同步進度與照片、幫真實隊友加油。訪客看不到其他玩家，舊本機紀錄需另行確認才匯入雲端。雲端 Widget 背景打卡及完整帳號刪除仍在開發，請使用測試資料並透過 TestFlight 回饋。
beta_review_notes: Omi is a community habit challenge beta. Login is optional: on the final onboarding step choose the local-use option to use check-ins, reflections and photos offline. Guests do not see other players. Starting with version 1.2.0, users may sign in with their own Discord account and create or join a Supabase-backed group for progress and photo sync. Existing local records are uploaded only after a separate import confirmation. Weight and reflection text are private within the app; progress and shared photos are accessible to group members. Cloud widgets currently open the app; background cloud actions and self-service account deletion are not implemented yet. This is a TestFlight beta, not an App Store production submission. Please use synthetic test data. On first launch complete the setup tutorial, then tap 每日打卡 and the keycap buttons. The privacy policy describes the optional cloud service.
